observations.rootCause: The failing half of the waitForFunction predicate (e2e/gm-campaign-ledger-control-plane.spec.ts:645-669) is campaign.name === expectedName, not coopSession.mode === 'guest'. The test stamps a stale local name ('__guest-client-stale__', spec:10) plus guest coopSession into the store WITHOUT saving (spec:266-310), then reloads. src/pages-modules/gameplay/campaigns/campaignPageShell.tsx:144-146 correctly forces a server refresh for a guest (guestNeedsServerRefresh, landed 2026-07-09 in ba92b4569 / #1022). But src/stores/campaign/useCampaignPersistenceStore.ts:696-712 then discards that refresh: evaluateCampaignCache (src/lib/campaign/persistence/campaignCacheKey.ts:63-81) compares only (instanceId, revision); the guest's local copy diverged in CONTENT without a revision bump, so the verdict is 'usable', cacheStands is true (:701-702), loadedCampaign is the stale local copy (:703-704) and writeLiveCampaign is skipped (:709-710). The stale name therefore survives forever and the predicate never becomes true.
